exceptions.reason: Chrome for Testing is installed under /opt/puppeteer and is not owned by dpkg or an application lockfile, so the generic Trivy OS/library scan does not establish its live CVE state. The image-scan jobs record the exact runtime version separately.
exceptions.removeWhen: A live browser-vulnerability intelligence source is enforced for the observed Chrome for Testing version, or the browser moves to a package/source covered by the release vulnerability gate.

exceptions.reason: The arm64 browser is Debian Chromium. Trivy sees the package, but the release scan intentionally uses ignore-unfixed, so HIGH/CRITICAL advisories without a vendor fix are not a release blocker. The image-scan jobs record the exact runtime version for review.
exceptions.removeWhen: No accepted unfixed HIGH/CRITICAL Chromium exposure remains, or arm64 moves to a browser source with an enforced live advisory gate.
